name: lattica-landing
description: Lattica landing page on Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.db:list: wrangler d1 execute lattica_waitlist --remote --command "SELECT email, datetime(created_at,'unixepoch') AS at FROM waitlist ORDER BY created_at DESC"
scripts.db:list:local: wrangler d1 execute lattica_waitlist --local --command "SELECT email, datetime(created_at,'unixepoch') AS at FROM waitlist ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.db:count: wrangler d1 execute lattica_waitlist --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM waitlist"
scripts.db:count:local: wrangler d1 execute lattica_waitlist --local --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM waitlist"
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && wrangler d1 migrations apply lattica_waitlist --local
